• Faster Movement Acceleration

en.body: Shares the 12 second global <strand/>Tangle creation cooldown.
Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.
Elemental Pickups include <solar/>Firesprites, <arc/>Ionic Traces, <stasis/>Stasis Shards, <strand/>Tangles, and <void/>Void Breaches.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in <link our explainer blog post on the Clarity website [https://url.d2clarity.com/chunk-energy-scalars] />.

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in <link our explainer blog post on the Clarity website [https://url.d2clarity.com/chunk-energy-scalars] />.

Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.
Loads bullets into your magazine but does not need a reload animation and doesn't trigger on-reload perks.
How much your Accuracy Cone expands with each shot fired by your weapon. The less the better.

<barrier/>Shield-Piercing weapons are required to break a <barrier/>Barrier Champion's immunity shield in order to stun them. Damaging their shields also halts their health regeneration for 1.6 seconds.

Additionally, Shield-Piercing weapons can overpenetrate an unlimited number of enemies. They also bypass Hydra Shields, Hobgoblin immunity, (Taken) Phalanx shields, and Scorn Buckler shields.

Titan Barricades receive 30% Increased Damage from Shield-Piercing weapons.

<overload/>Overload Shots/effects apply <overload/>Disruption for <pve 6.5 /> <pvp [5] /> seconds. Applying Disruption stuns <overload/>Overload Champions and prevents them from regenerating health for the duration of the effect.

Disruption decreases damage dealt by PvE Combatants by 25%. It also decreases Melee, Grenade, and Class Ability regeneration speeds by 40% in PvP.
<unstoppable/>Unstoppable Shots/effects are required to stun <unstoppable/>Unstoppable Champions – immobilizing them and removing their passive 70% Damage Resistance for the duration of the stun.
